# goo.gl
> Google URL Shortener was a Google service for creating shortened links and viewing basic click analytics.

The service has been discontinued for new and existing short links, and its remaining public documentation is limited. Most relevant context now lives in Google support, developer, and migration-related pages.

## Product Overview
- [Google URL Shortener announcement](https://developers.googleblog.com/2018/03/transitioning-google-url-shortener.html): Official announcement describing the shutdown timeline and Firebase Dynamic Links migration path.
- [Google URL Shortener support](https://support.google.com/faqs/answer/190768): Help Center article explaining the deprecation and discontinuation of goo.gl.
- [Google Developers Blog](https://developers.googleblog.com/): Google’s developer blog, including historical posts about product transitions and platform changes.
- [Google for Developers](https://developers.google.com/): Main developer portal for Google products, APIs, tools, and platform documentation.

## Shutdown and Migration
- [Transitioning Google URL Shortener](https://developers.googleblog.com/2018/03/transitioning-google-url-shortener.html): Details shutdown milestones, existing link behavior, and recommended migration to Firebase Dynamic Links.
- [Firebase Dynamic Links](https://firebase.google.com/products/dynamic-links): Replacement product previously recommended for deep links and app-aware link routing.
- [Dynamic Links documentation](https://firebase.google.com/docs/dynamic-links): Guides and reference for creating and handling Firebase Dynamic Links.
- [Dynamic Links REST API](https://firebase.google.com/docs/reference/dynamic-links/link-shortener): API reference for programmatically creating short dynamic links.
- [Firebase console](https://console.firebase.google.com/): Management console for Firebase projects and Dynamic Links configuration.

## Help Center
- [Google URL Shortener FAQ](https://support.google.com/faqs/answer/190768): Primary support article covering the service shutdown and expected behavior.
- [Google Account Help](https://support.google.com/accounts/): Support resources for account access issues that may affect historical Google services.
- [Google Help](https://support.google.com/): Central support hub for Google products and service-specific help articles.

## Firebase Alternatives
- [Firebase documentation](https://firebase.google.com/docs): Central documentation hub for Firebase products and developer guides.
- [Dynamic Links create links manually](https://firebase.google.com/docs/dynamic-links/create-manually): Guide to constructing Dynamic Links with parameters and platform behavior.
- [Receive Dynamic Links on Android](https://firebase.google.com/docs/dynamic-links/android/receive): Android integration guide for handling incoming dynamic links in apps.
- [Receive Dynamic Links on iOS](https://firebase.google.com/docs/dynamic-links/ios/receive): iOS integration guide for receiving and processing dynamic links.
- [Receive Dynamic Links on Flutter](https://firebase.google.com/docs/dynamic-links/flutter/receive): Flutter guide for app setup and incoming dynamic link handling.
- [Analytics with Dynamic Links](https://firebase.google.com/docs/dynamic-links/analytics): Documentation for measuring Dynamic Links performance and attribution.

## Developer Resources
- [Google APIs Explorer](https://developers.google.com/apis-explorer): Interactive tool for exploring supported Google APIs and request formats.
- [Google API Console](https://console.cloud.google.com/apis/dashboard): Cloud console for managing APIs, credentials, and project configuration.
- [Google Identity](https://developers.google.com/identity): Authentication and authorization documentation for Google developer integrations.
- [Google Terms of Service](https://policies.google.com/terms): Terms governing use of Google services and websites.
- [Google Privacy Policy](https://policies.google.com/privacy): Privacy information relevant to Google-hosted products and services.

## Historical Context
- [Google URL Shortener discontinued](https://support.google.com/faqs/answer/190768): Historical support notice documenting the end of goo.gl operations.
- [Transitioning Google URL Shortener](https://developers.googleblog.com/2018/03/transitioning-google-url-shortener.html): Historical blog post marking the product’s retirement and migration recommendation.
- [Firebase Dynamic Links product page](https://firebase.google.com/products/dynamic-links): Product page for the successor service Google recommended after goo.gl.

## Related Google Platforms
- [Firebase](https://firebase.google.com/): Google’s app development platform with hosting, analytics, and linking capabilities.
- [Google Cloud](https://cloud.google.com/): Cloud platform for backend services, APIs, and infrastructure used by developers.
- [Android Developers](https://developer.android.com/): Android platform documentation relevant to app link and deep link implementation.
- [Apple Universal Links overview](https://developer.apple.com/ios/universal-links/): Apple documentation relevant to deep-link behavior on iOS platforms.
